requirement: A failed teardown's reason reaches the person deleting the site, cut to this site's own names

Red f45c9b944 (the route case not ok on 8d635fc41), fix c18f9b484.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 120): the database cases ran, none skipped.
